ob2022.title: OceanBase: A 707 Million tpmC Distributed Relational Database System
ob2022.author: Zhenkun Yang, Chuanhui Yang, Fusheng Han, Mingqiang Zhuang, Bing Yang, Zhifeng Yang, Xiaojun Cheng, Yuzhong Zhao, Wenhui Shi, Huafeng Xi, Huang Yu, Bin Liu, Yi Pan, Boxue Yin, Junquan Chen, Quanqing Xu
ob2022.quote: We launched the design and development of OceanBase [6, 7], a commodity hardware-based distributed relational database system from the very basics, in May 2010. OceanBase has been first used as the Favorite of Taobao.com [3] in 2011, a service similar to the Wish List of Amazon.com [11]. Thereafter, it was used by Alipay.com, in 2014, and by Zhejiang E-Commerce Bank in 2015
ob2022.quote2: We initially built OceanBase as a distributed NoSQL storage system for the Favorite of Taobao.com [3] in 2010. As shown in Figure 15, there are three stages for OceanBase evolution, viz., (1) Stage 1: Towards a distributed architecture from 2010 to 2012, primarily focusing on distributed NoSQL storage, (2) Stage 2: Native distributed database from 2013 to 2016, starting with SQL engine and enhancing Paxos-based high availability, (3) Stage 3: Hybrid transactional and analytical processing (HTAP) system from 2017 to current
ob2022.quote3: OceanBase has been employed to serve the Favorite of Taobao.com since June 2011.
supports: Taobao Favourites is a wish-list service

paetica2023.title: OceanBase Paetica: A Hybrid Shared-nothing/Shared-everything Database for Supporting Single Machine and Distributed Cluster
paetica2023.author: Zhifeng Yang, Quanqing Xu, Shanyan Gao, Chuanhui Yang, Guoping Wang, Yuzhong Zhao, Fanyu Kong, Hao Liu, Wanhong Wang, Jinliang Xiao
paetica2023.quote: the UpdateServer node is a single-point write, multi-point read architecture, which is similar to PolarDB [13][29] and makes it difficult to expand when higher levels of concurrency become necessary.
paetica2023.quote2: The ChunkServer is characterized by the capability for automatic partitioning and horizontal scalability of storage. The UpdateServer utilizes the Paxos protocol [28] to attain strong consistency and availability. However, the UpdateServer does not possess the capability for distributed transactions. Such an architecture can enable OceanBase to better support businesses similar to Taobao favorites [1].
paetica2023.quote3: To address the aforementioned issues, OceanBase has abandoned its previous architecture and developed the version 1.0 ~ 3.0, which is characterized by a fully peer-to-peer (P2P) structure

chuanhui2011.title: Oceanbase - Qian Yi Ji Hai Liang Shu Ju Ku (Oceanbase - a hundred-billion-scale massive database)
chuanhui2011.author: Chuanhui (NOSQL Notes, nosqlnotes.net; the about page reads "KO (chuanhui), Tech Evangelist ... work@Baidu work@Taobao")
chuanhui2011.quote: 淘宝Oceanbase设计之初对淘宝的在线存储需求进行分析发现：淘宝的数据总量比较大，未来一段时间，比如五年之内的数据规模为百TB级别，千亿条记录，另外，数据膨胀很快，传统的分库分表对业务造成很大的压力，必须设计自动化的分布式系统；然而，在线存储每天的修改量很小，大多数情况下单机的内存就能存放下。因此，我们采用将动态数据和静态数据分离的办法。
chuanhui2011.quote_translation: When Taobao Oceanbase was first designed, an analysis of Taobao's online storage requirements found: Taobao's total data volume is fairly large - over the coming period, say within five years, the data scale will be on the order of a hundred TB (百TB级别) and a hundred billion records; moreover the data is expanding fast, and traditional database/table sharding puts great pressure on the business, so an automated distributed system must be designed. However, the daily volume of modification in online storage is very small, and in most cases a single machine's memory can hold it. Therefore we adopted the approach of separating dynamic data from static data.
chuanhui2011.quote2: 动态数据的数据量小，采用集中式的方法解决，这样，状态数据维持从一个分布式的问题转化为单机的问题；静态数据的数据量大，采用分布式的方法解决
chuanhui2011.quote2_translation: The dynamic data is small in volume and is solved with a centralized approach, so that maintaining state data is converted from a distributed problem into a single-machine problem; the static data is large in volume and is solved with a distributed approach
supports: hundreds of TB and a hundred billion records within five years
sharding by database and table was straining the business
daily change volume fits one machine's memory
the daily merge that turns incremental data into the new baseline
chuanhui2011.quote3: 确切地说是：基准数据和增量数据。比如每天早上凌晨1点合并，那么1点之前的数据是基准数据，1点之后的数据是增量数据。基准数据和增量数据合并生成新的基准数据，是一个动态的概念。
chuanhui2011.quote3_translation: More precisely: baseline data and incremental data. Say the merge runs at 1am each morning - then the data from before 1am is the baseline data and the data after 1am is the incremental data. Merging baseline and incremental data produces the new baseline; it is a moving definition. (Author's own reply in the post's comment thread.)
chuanhui2011.note: Recovered from the Wayback snapshot of 2011-07-01; the post's own byline reads 于2011 年 04 月 22 日 上午 9:18发表在. The blog's 关于作者 page (same snapshot window) reads "KO (chuanhui)，Tech Evangelist" with "work@Baidu" and "work@Taobao".

obdesign.title: OceanBase 架构初探 (A first look at the OceanBase architecture) - a reposted write-up of the OceanBase 0.5 design reasoning, authorship unestablished
obdesign.author: Reposted at cnblogs.com/yaoyangding (blog owner 耀阳居士). The pasted page furniture credits CSDN user 衣舞晨风 / xunzaosiyecao and reads "原创 ... 发布于2018-11-13", i.e. the text arrived by copy; the underlying authorship is not established on the page.
obdesign.quote: 有些范围查询需要访问几乎所有的分区，例如，按照user_id分区，查询收藏了一个商品的所有用户需要访问所有的分区；
obdesign.quote_translation: Some range queries need to access almost all partitions; for example, when partitioned by user_id, querying all the users who favourited a given item requires accessing all the partitions;
obdesign.quote2: 虽然在线业务的数据量十分庞大，例如几十亿条、上百亿条甚至更多记录，但最近一段时间（例如一天）的修改量往往并不多，通常不超过几千万条到几亿条，因此，OceanBase决定采用单台更新服务器来记录最近一段时间的修改增量，而以前的数据保持不变，以前的数据称为基线数据。
obdesign.quote2_translation: Although the data volume of online business is very large - for example several billion, over ten billion or even more records - the volume of modification in a recent period (for example one day) is usually not large, typically no more than tens of millions to a few hundred million records. OceanBase therefore decided to use a single update server to record the recent modification increment, while the older data stays unchanged; the older data is called baseline data.
obdesign.quote3: 这样，写事务都集中在单台更新服务器上，避免了复杂的分布式事务，高效地实现了跨行跨表事务；…当然，单台更新服务器的处理能力总是有一定的限制。
obdesign.quote3_translation: In this way write transactions are all concentrated on a single update server, avoiding complex distributed transactions and efficiently implementing cross-row, cross-table transactions; ... Of course, the processing capacity of a single update server always has a certain limit.
obdesign.confidence: secondary - a copy of a copy; used only for the favourites/user_id example and the single-update-server rationale, neither of which is attributed to OceanBase in the prose
supports: partitioning by user_id makes 'who favourited this item' read every partition
why a single UpdateServer was chosen
the single UpdateServer has a hard capacity limit
obdesign.note: The cnblogs page's own metadata (JSON-LD datePublished, post-date footer, cb_entryCreatedDate) all read 2019-12-13 01:44. The 2018-11-13 timestamp visible in the body belongs to the CSDN article whose HTML was pasted in. Both Chinese passages below were re-read from the live page on 2026-08-22 and match character for character.

unverified: Who wrote the design-rationale text carried by the `obdesign` page. It is widely reproduced and is commonly said to be section 9.1 of Yang Chuanhui's book 'Large-Scale Distributed Storage Systems: Principles and Architecture in Practice' (2013), but the printed book was not opened, the cnblogs page is itself a copy of a CSDN post, and that CSDN post claims the text as 原创 (original). The prose therefore no longer says 'their design rationale says' - it states the partition consequence plainly and cites the page for the favourites example only.

That the 'Chuanhui' who wrote the 2011 nosqlnotes.net post is Chuanhui Yang, the OceanBase co-author of the two VLDB papers. The blog's about page confirms only 'KO (chuanhui) ... work@Taobao'. The prose says 'a Taobao engineer posting as Chuanhui' and claims no more.
Zhenkun Yang's personal role in 2010. He is first author of the 2022 PVLDB paper, but neither paper says who led or founded the team, so no leadership claim is made.

A row count for the Taobao Favourites table itself. The sources give Taobao-wide figures (a five-year projection of a hundred TB and a hundred billion records; 'several billion, over ten billion or even more records' for online business generally), not a count for that one table. The prose calls the projection 'the site's', not the table's.

That 'everyone who saved this item' was a business requirement of equal weight to 'everything one user saved'. The only source naming that read is `obdesign`; the two peer-reviewed papers say only that the 0.5 architecture suited 'businesses similar to Taobao favorites'.

The exact date the single-UpdateServer write path left production. The 2022 paper dates the SQL/Paxos work to a 2013-2016 stage and the 2023 paper says only that versions 1.0-3.0 abandoned the architecture.
